title: Systems Trade Rates for Cash Settlements — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
A systems-item cash settlement under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty is struck on the item under settlement: the claim item of the most recent systems approval recorded on the coverage, whether that approval is the item's original approval or an accepted callback. The settlement carries a systems trade multiplier, applied to the program's cash-in-lieu maximum in the scheduled systems settlement.

**Rule.** The systems trade multiplier follows the defect category of the item under settlement, as the item was filed: an hvac item takes 1.25; a plumbing item takes 1.15; any other systems item takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

| Defect category of the item under settlement | Systems trade multiplier |
|---|---|
| hvac | 1.25 |
| plumbing | 1.15 |
| any other systems item | 1.00 |

**Identifying the item.** Where a plumbing item was approved first and an accepted callback on an hvac item is the latest systems approval on the coverage, the item under settlement is the hvac item and the multiplier is 1.25.
